idea: Seasonal (Halloween) music clip in the PLAYROOM: a pumpkin on the little table has a sad crayon face; Jimmy and Ava gasp, Ava pats it kindly, Jimmy has an idea with the black crayon, they draw it a big smile and it glows happily. Lesson: share a smile - a kind smile makes a friend happy.
title: Oh No! Sad Halloween Pumpkin! 🎃 Share a Smile | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! The pumpkin in the playroom looks so sad! 🎃 Baby Jimmy and Baby Ava pat it gently, grab a crayon and draw a big happy smile – and the pumpkin glows with joy!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! Sad pumpkin!"
🤗 Ava pats the pumpkin: "Don't be sad!"
🖍️ Jimmy has an idea with his crayon
😊 They draw a big smile
✨ Happy pumpkin! Clap, clap, hooray!
👋 Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: share a smile and be kind to friends • English words: sad, happy, pumpkin, smile, crayon, clap

A fun, friendly Halloween cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about kindness, feelings and sharing a smile – nothing scary!

Kids cartoon • Halloween for kids • Pumpkin song • Feelings for kids • Kindness for kids • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning
